<!-- pr-reviewer: 837122b4fbb0af55beeae2a2acced8170ebccea5 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Default output is untouched: `endUnitsWord()` returns "" unless the option is set and differs from the program's unit (`assets/posts/tormach.cps`), and `options_value` only adds `EndUnits` when set. Conformance goldens are unchanged.
- Placement is right: `onClose` is `endPreamble(); retract(); [G20|G21]; M30`, so the word comes after the final `G53 G0 Z0` / `G30` and never before any motion. Inch program with "mm" gives G21; mm program with "inch" gives G20; matching units add nothing (covered by `tormach_end_units`).
- Option is a typed enum (`EndUnits`) in `schema.rs`, set through the existing undoable `SetPostOptions` (UI test covers commit and undo). The project file key is additive (no version step), absent means default, and an unknown word is refused by name in `project/apply.rs`. Default writes no key.
- UI row is shown only for Tormach PathPilot. Decision file `docs/decisions/596-end-native-units.md` and a `Changelog:` line are present, and the body ends `Fixes #596`. No CHANGELOG.md edit, no snapshot PNG change, no build.rs / .github / scripts / dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, which was already up to date)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| app: tormach_end_units | 7 passed |
| app: tormach_post | 10 passed |
| app: tormach_machines | 5 passed |
| app: conformance | 6 passed |
| app: posting | 17 passed |
| app: project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from crates/ui) | 376 passed, 2 failed: `headless_run_succeeds` (no graphics adapter, known on this Mac) and `structural::shell_structure_light` (frame-edge sync, a global that races under parallel runs; passes on its own, with `end_units_choice_commits_and_undoes` also passing) |
| clippy -D warnings, app + ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_options.rs` hover text is one very long line; cosmetic.
- Not exercised: a PathPilot Hub run with the option set (as the PR states).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
